summary: Verified reported 'bot joins voice but no sound' bug is fixed. Ran DIAG harness end-to-end: HTTP-DIRECT OK (pos=3960ms), SOUNDCLOUD OK (pos=3900ms), YOUTUBE+FB OK (pos=3940ms). Lavalink 4.2.2 healthy locally, /api/bot/status returns online=true with 98 guilds and fresh updated_at.
critical_code_review_comments: Diagnostic harness is a good sanctioned e2e proof; consider removing the /tmp/pupu_diag.flag hook (or gating it behind an env var) before production to avoid accidental auto-joins.
pupu_bot.py should ensure /tmp/pupu_diag.flag is cleared after run automatically to prevent repeat DIAG joins on every restart (currently the flag needs manual removal).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Lavalink runs locally on port 2333 (password pupu2026), youtube-plugin 1.18.2. To rerun playback proof: `touch /tmp/pupu_diag.flag && sudo supervisorctl restart pupu_bot`, wait ~90s, grep DIAG in /var/log/supervisor/pupu_bot.err.log. Remove flag afterwards. /api/bot/status endpoint verified. Earlier DIAG runs (05:25-05:30) showed SOUNDCLOUD/YOUTUBE 'search returned nothing' before Lavalink was fully warm; after warmup at 05:32 and again at 05:35 all three sources succeeded — so a cold-start warmup window (~3-5 min after Lavalink boot) should be respected before running diagnostics.
